question:

Each employee filled out a profile including three likes or hobbies. On the day of the gift exchange, only eleven gifts were given, each one specific to one of the recipient's interests. Based on the information in the document, who did not give a gift?

```python
# Interest mapping assumptions
gift_interest_map = {
    "Galileo Galilei biography": "Astronomy",           # Miguel
    "Fishing reel": "Fishing",                           # Harry
    "Raku programming guide": "Perl",                    # Fred (Raku related to Perl)
    "Chisel set": "Woodworking",                         # Jun
    "Custom dice": "Tabletop RPGs",                      # Sara
    "“War and Peace” American film copy": "Old Movies",   # Perry
    "Yarn": "Knitting",                                  # Micah
    "“One Piece” graphic novel": "Manga",                 # Alex
    "“War and Peace” novel": "Historical Fiction Novels", # Tyson
    "Starbucks gift card": "Coffee",                      # Lucy
    "Foam exercise mat": "Yoga"                           # Georgette
}

matched = {}
for gift, interest in gift_interest_map.items():
    for name, interests in profiles.items():
        if interest in interests:
            matched[gift] = name
            break

matched_employees = set(matched.values())
missing = set(employees) - matched_employees

print("Matched recipients:")
for g, n in matched.items():
    print(f"{g} -> {n}")

print("\nEmployee(s) missing a gift:")
print(missing)
```
